actual.scope: All stored actual raw cycles are retained. Maximum-g statements are only over this finite stored sample. The full all-rotation bounds are identities or necessary divisibility bounds, not a new universal cycle exclusion.

clock: Raw positive odd-only cycles without an absorber. Primitive cycles, repeated words, source scalings and additive parameters are distinguished.

generated.scope: The bounded family checks are examples supporting the separately written all-M obstruction. The arbitrary-M proof is not inferred from these twelve moduli. Repetitions are kept separate, including every repetition of the trivial word(2). The two-defect word(3,7) retains an extra factor5 in the cut gcd, refuting an unqualified equality with g.

marker_family.scope: Eight bounded examples of the separately written marker family. Full raw arrows and all rotations were checked. The shortcut local-minimum count is separate from odd-only minima. No published lower bound or all-size analytic theorem is independently verified by these examples.

rejection_controls.scope: Reject nonpositive valuations, negative cycle denominator, zero unit-stripping and a wrong supplied raw state. Repeated words are analyzed, not rejected.

scope: Exact rotation/intercept identities, unit-stripped divisibility bounds, finite actual controls and bounded examples of an unbounded-cancellation family. No unrestricted integer-cycle exclusion, formal proof, novelty claim or improvement to published cycle records is asserted.
